noun_definition: Logging refers to the process of recording events or messages in the system to help diagnose issues, particularly regarding the application's offline state and API request behavior.
offline state refers to the condition in which the application incorrectly indicates that the user is not connected to the internet, resulting in misleading messages and API request behaviors.
Bugs refer to issues in the application that cause incorrect behavior, such as displaying an offline message when the user is actually online or incorrectly handling API requests.
